scope: Durable errors and prevention rules from the current Bedrijfsgeheugen execution chat line. Duplicate historical learnings are referenced, not rewritten.

failures.symptom: An older PR still described a Make capacity blocker as active after runtime recovery had already been proven.
failures.rootCause: Candidate content and blocker truth were not revalidated against current authoritative state immediately before promotion.
failures.failedApproach: Merge an old candidate because most of its content is still useful.
failures.provenFix: Re-read current main and current blocker/runtime evidence; preserve only still-valid deltas in a current-main successor and close the stale predecessor as superseded.
evidence: PR #894 closed as superseded by merged PR #901

failures.symptom: Shared Agent Memory repeatedly failed around the 256 KB limit even after shrinking one linked projection.
failures.rootCause: The compiler charged full canonical source-corpus bytes against the bounded agent preflight packet budget. Brain growth and emitted context size were conflated.
failures.failedApproach: Keep deleting useful projection content to get just below the byte ceiling.
failures.provenFix: Read, validate and hash all canonical sources, track sourceBytes separately for audit, and enforce maxBytes on the actually serialized emitted preflight packet only.
failures.regressionContract: Shared Agent Memory Tests plus chat-learning preflight maxBytes fail-closed tests
evidence: PR #901 exact-head Shared Agent Memory and Brain foundation gates green after compiler fix

failures.symptom: Configuratiewacht rejected the new SEO Guardian because it could fail without a durable machine-readable explanation of the reason.
failures.rootCause: A failing workflow relied on PR commentary/output rather than guaranteeing an error annotation or durable issue/update path in the same run.
failures.failedApproach: Treat a red job itself as sufficient observability.
failures.provenFix: Every workflow that can return non-zero must emit a machine-readable failure reason such as ::error:: or create/update a durable issue; detailed PR diagnostics may supplement but not replace this.
evidence: Configuratiewacht changed from failure to success after SEO Guardian emitted self-describing errors

failures.symptom: Unified BRAIN Delivery failed even though SEO-specific gates were green because scripts/ci/keyword_strategy_guardian.py, scripts/ci/seo_guardian.py, seo/keyword-strategy.json and zelfscan.html were unclassified.
failures.rootCause: New executable/content ownership paths were introduced without a same-change update to central delivery lane membership.
failures.failedApproach: Assume a feature-specific green workflow is sufficient for delivery eligibility.
failures.provenFix: Classify every new executable or governed content path in the canonical delivery system in the same candidate; then rerun exact-head central delivery.
failures.regressionContract: Learning Contract Delivery Classifier Tests and Unified BRAIN Delivery
evidence: BRAIN delivery PR #903 failed at plan with explicit unclassified-path diagnostics

failures.symptom: The older SEO candidate contained a branch-specific workflow that mutated and pushed repairs directly to its own branch.
failures.rootCause: Historical self-heal mechanics predated candidate-only centralized writer governance and retained direct write authority inside a feature workflow.
failures.failedApproach: Carry the whole stale implementation forward unchanged because its functional checks are useful.
failures.provenFix: Retain read-only guardians and deterministic diagnostics, remove embedded self-writer/direct-push behavior, and route mutations through the canonical candidate/promotion authority.
failures.regressionContract: Repository writer governance plus candidate-only delivery preflight
evidence: SEO successor #903 explicitly removed seo-baseline-fixer.yml and fix_seo_baseline.py

cross_cutting_invariants: Current authoritative runtime state wins over stale PR/body/history text.
Canonical Brain corpus may grow; bounded agent context must remain independently budgeted.
A red workflow without a machine-readable reason is an observability defect.
Feature-specific green does not override central delivery classification.
Guardians observe and diagnose; canonical writer/promotion authority owns mutations.
